# has capacity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCapacity`](gmeow-hasCapacity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCapacity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Links a location to a capacity measurement describing the maximum number of entities it can hold. Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified [`Capacity`](../classes/gmeow-Capacity.md) when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.
